We sent Nuh to his people: Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.
He said: O my people, I am a clear warner to you.
Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
He will forgive some of your sins and give you time until a set time. When Allah's time comes, it cannot be put off, if you only knew.
He said: My Lord, I called my people night and day.
But my calling only made them run away more.
Each time I called them to be forgiven by You, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, kept on, and became very proud.
Then I called them out loud.
Then I spoke to them openly, and I spoke to them in secret.
I said: Ask your Lord to forgive you. He is the Forgiving.
He will send the sky pouring rain on you.
And give you money and children, and give you gardens and rivers.
What is wrong with you, that you do not think of Allah as great?
He made you in stages.
Do you not see how Allah made seven skies, one over the other?
And He put the moon in them as a light, and made the sun a lamp.
And Allah made you grow from the earth like plants.
Then He will return you into it, and bring you out again.
And Allah made the earth a wide place for you.
So that you can walk on its wide roads.
Nuh said: My Lord, they did not obey me. They followed a person whose money and children only made him lose more.
And they made big plans against me.
And they said: Do not give up your gods! Do not give up Wadd, or Suwa, or Yaghuth, or Ya'uq, or Nasr.
They have led many people away. So do not give the wrongdoers anything but more trouble.
Because of their wrong they were drowned and put into a Fire. They found no helpers other than Allah.
Nuh said: My Lord, do not leave any person on the earth who says no.
If You leave them, they will lead Your servants away and will only have bad children who say no.
My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and anyone who comes into my house as a believer, and all believing men and women. And do not give the wrongdoers anything but loss.
